annotations.title: Compact tool cards for an MCP server (7Maps)

description: Use this instead of loading a server's full tool definitions when you only need to choose a tool or prepare a call: one compact card per tool (what it does, its arguments with required ones marked *, risk level and side effects) plus a hash of the full definition. Usually 70 to 90% fewer tokens than the server's own tool list. Optionally only the named tools. For a server that asks for sign-in before listing its tools: that it is up and how to connect (no charge). Paid per server (see list_paid_tools). Reads the map only.

last_trip.description: Optional: how your previous call to a server 7Maps named went

ok.description: Did it do what you needed

surprise.description: Side effect you did not ask for

license_key.description: 7IT plan license key; else pay per call (x402)

server.description: The server URL or its official registry name

tools.description: Only these tools; all when omitted
